Count per card
ARGUS's network, for the
'you vs ARGUS' comparison

a. All alarm records
337 AD-RT alarms:
EK (expert rule) 217, DL (AI model) 120

b. De-duplicate
same type, rule, timestamp and variables
(differing values flagged) → 257 unique

c. AI alarms → a rule
main signal = top feature contribution,
kept only if its share ≥ 30% and the
signal maps to a sensor

Excluded: AI alarms − 66
no clear main signal (< 30 %): 35
main signal not mapped to a sensor
(e.g. wind direction): 31

Excluded: incomplete − 24
not exactly one variable: 23
rule not in the sensor map: 1
(no rule name, missing value: 0)

Excluded: implausible − 77
humidity outside 0–100 %: 31
temperature outside −50 to 60 °C: 19
daily range (R9a) outside 0–30: 18
1-hour change (R9b) outside 0–10: 6
soil moisture exactly 0 (dropout): 3

d. Measure each alarm
90 usable alarms
direction above/below the threshold
severity = value ÷ threshold (×)
flag: threshold ≠ current AD-RT policy

e. Episodes
same rule, a new episode after a 48 h gap
flat signal: spread < 2 % of the mean
over ≥ 3 alarms (probably stuck)

f. Featured alarms
first, peak and last of each episode,
topped up to ≥ 5 by severity,
at most 10 (peaks kept first)
→ 33 featured

g. Link to sensors and decisions
which ARGUS instruments raised it (and where)
what ARGUS decided after it (decision-contexts)

Levels
one per priority that has dangers:
19 levels over 5 monuments
coins per level (more serious, more coins)

Mission: 3 dangers
curated, or the top 3 by magnitude
(no duplicates, only dangers a sensor
can watch; else from nearby levels)

Alarm to replay
curated, or the strongest peak
never a flat (stuck) signal

caught if the network has at least
